short_description: Immerse yourself in a world where Iwa sets out to find her kidnapped brother! Enjoy atmospheric, peaceful gameplay and, over time, solve simple puzzles. Use traps and your own wits to eliminate opponents! Buy The Mystical Books and Skills! Discover this world in your own way.
steam_categories: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Custom Volume Controls; Playable without Timed Input; Family Sharing
